lab_declaration: 本任务属于 aetfq3-lab / Lab，不属于 V2.1 Stable。
boundary_statement: Lab-only supervised label/outcome design; no real label file generation, no training, no QMT, no OrderIntent, no Stable effect.
phase: F public intraday supervised label / outcome design

labels.name: buy_now_label
labels.generation_rule: derived only from data after the current bar

labels.name: wait_pullback_label
labels.generation_rule: derived only from data after the current bar

labels.name: cancel_buy_label
labels.generation_rule: derived only from data after the current bar

labels.name: three_day_positive_label
labels.generation_rule: derived from future three-day or equivalent future-window outcome

label_generation_principles: labels/outcomes can only be generated from data after the current bar
current bar features may only use the current bar or earlier data
label_horizon must be recorded for each bar_index
missing future windows must set label_status=insufficient_future_window
fake labels must not be filled
synthetic labels must not be marked as real
QMT fill returns must not be used as features
real trade results must not be used as features
the label design is not trading advice

label_source_kind.rule: synthetic_mock must not be marked as real

label_horizon.rule: must record the horizon for each bar_index

label_generation_method.rule: must be versioned or otherwise auditable

insufficient_future_window_policy.recommended_value: set label_status=insufficient_future_window and exclude from supervised target

leakage_checker_design.input: supervised intraday manifest plus optional schema metadata
leakage_checker_design.output: p0_blockers, p1_warnings, overlap details, boundary flags
required_p0_checks: current bar feature uses future bar
label generated without sufficient future window
QMT fill/real trade result used as feature

next_steps: Implement a manifest-only label leakage checker using this checklist.
Require future-window data, hash, source note, manifest, and human authorization before any real label generation.
Run intake-only and leakage-only checks before any supervised dry validation.
